column1: # Game profile of Sam & Max: The Devil's Playhouse (Switch, update 1.8.0 = v524288 on the base game v0). Runs on the Mac: reaches its frame loop and draws with its own shaders, sound and controller, no red line. See README.md

# Telltale Tool (SM3_nx_*.ttarch2 archives, Lua scripts), FMOD sound, SDK 17.5.6, NVN. The shaders are in an effect pack inside SM3_nx_Shaders_mem.ttarch2 and SM3_nx_ShadersPatch.ttarch2 (shader_split.py ttarch2_shaders).
# Every value below is still the provisional profile's guess (profile_guess.py from the survey): the game ran with it and none needed changing.

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
